Learning and enquiry terms

Current website version: 13 November 2026.

Planning-stage courses

Course durations and formats are proposals. This website does not accept payments or confirm enrolment. Review the final dates, fees, delivery mode, equipment requirements and inclusions before making a commitment.

Certificates and affiliations

Academy course completion is distinct from vendor certification. No official EC-Council partnership, accredited ISO Lead Auditor qualification or CERT-In recognition is claimed. External exams and subscriptions are separate unless expressly included in a future written offer.

Assessment and recruitment

Completion depends on the published assessment criteria and professional conduct. No job or exam outcome is guaranteed. Any recruitment process is separate, and course purchase is not a prerequisite to apply.

Safe practice

Use only assigned labs and authorised targets. Do not test third-party systems, collect real credentials or share confidential information as part of a training exercise.

Fees, cancellations and refunds

There is no paid enrolment or refund transaction on this website yet. The academy must publish the actual operator, written payment terms, cancellation/refund policy and support contact before accepting any fees.

Materials

Course descriptions and samples are educational resources. Vendor trademarks belong to their respective owners. No vendor courseware or exam questions are supplied as official content.
